## Why
Verify {{title}} through the installed Rust CLI and real native platform evidence.

## Scope
Only the isolated SpecGit 2 qualification branches and their deliberately associated native issues are included.

## Approach
Create or adopt exact native objects, read their current identities, and execute the owned-runner fixture verification.

## Acceptance
The intended native association and verification result must be read back; unknown, failed or missing evidence must remain rejected. No merge or publication is performed.
